test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a grammatical error. Select the option that has the error.**

After a month-long vacation due to the sudden floods, Mani’s school has been resuming today.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'has been resuming'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'is resuming'** should be used instead of **'has been resuming'.**
 
• The following time expressions are commonly used with the present continuous tense: **today, at present, at the moment, still, now, etc**.
 
 
• *Example: He **is coming **home tonight.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *After a month-long vacation due to the sudden floods, Mani's school **is resuming** today.*
